newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - March 13.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - March 13.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The low in natural float occurred on Monday at about $350 million. The high in natural float was a bit under $1.3 billion on Thursday.
Transporation float averaged a bit under $100 million per day with the high on Thursday at about $600 million primarily due to weather related delays in the Midwest.
